name: Reverses, Suck-backs & Downlifters
when_to_use: Leading into a hard cut or hit, returning to the speaker after B-roll, 'wait, rewind' beats, ending a sequence (a falling tone reads as an ending), winding down after a big hit.

sounds.name: Reverse Hiss Suck-In 01
sounds.desc: A half-second bright air hiss that swells and stops sharply, like a sci-fi door sealing shut, to suck into a hard cut or close a panel.

sounds.name: Reverse Hiss Suck-In 02
sounds.desc: An alternate half-second rising pneumatic hiss that cuts off hard, for leading into a smash cut or a panel snapping shut.

sounds.name: Reverse Hiss Suck-In 03
sounds.desc: A third half-second bright hiss that builds and cuts off, for a quick suck-back before a hit or cut.
